name: Nagatsuki Amane
source:
A woman of the streets who has been dragged into this strange world. She is actually a very carefree and outgoing individual and acts kind of like the groups anchor in the storm. She tries to see the better things to come but also has some inner demons of her own that she does not share right away with everyone.

[From [url=http://theothersideofanime.blogspot.com/2014/03/forest-review-no-spoilers-here_24.html]The Other Side of Anime[/url]]
